depConstraints.description: Enterprise business rules sit at the centre: entities depend on nothing outside their own layer.
depConstraints.remediation: Move the collaborator into layer:entities, or invert the dependency so the outer layer depends on the entity.

depConstraints.description: Application business rules may reach inward to entities and sideways within their own layer, never outward.
depConstraints.remediation: Declare a port in layer:use-cases and let layer:interface-adapters implement it.

depConstraints.description: Controllers, presenters and gateways convert between the outside world and the use cases; they never depend on a framework project.
depConstraints.remediation: Keep the framework detail in layer:frameworks and pass it in through the adapter's own interface.

depConstraints.description: Drivers, delivery mechanisms and the composition root — the only layer allowed to know every other one.
depConstraints.remediation: Nothing inside this layer may be imported from a project tagged with an inner layer; move the shared piece inward instead.

depConstraints.description: The Dependency Rule applied to third-party code: entities import no package outside the workspace, Node built-ins included.
depConstraints.remediation: Wrap the package behind an interface owned by layer:entities and implement it in an outer layer.

depConstraints.description: Application business rules stay framework-free for the same reason entities do.
depConstraints.remediation: Declare a port for the capability and let layer:interface-adapters bring the package in.
